title: Annotatio III §.V: New Latino-German edition plus Prefatio with nine arguments prove its perfection — no need to linger on cause or praise
pass_a_gloss: But of this, since we have not only now prepared a new Latino-German edition, but have also established its Perfection — by which it leaves all Protestant Consensuses to a one many parasangs behind itself — in a peculiar Prefatio prefixed, by nine most evident arguments, having also solved all the exceptions that are commonly wont to be opposed here, there is no reason why we should linger further either on stating its cause or on recommending its excellence.
pass_b_english: Of this Consensus we have not only prepared a new Latino-German edition, but in a special Prefatio set out nine clearest arguments for the perfection by which it leaves every other Protestant consensus many parasangs behind — and we have answered all the usual objections.
So there is no need to linger further either stating its cause or praising its excellence.
source_text: Hujus verò, cùm non tantùm editionem novam Latino-Germanicam nunc paraverimus, sed & Perfectionem ejus, quâ Consensus Protestanticos ad unum omnes, multis post se parasangis relinquit, in peculiari praemissa Prefatione, novem evidentissimis argumentis adstruxerimus, solutis etiam, quae hic opponi vulgò solent, exceptionibus cunctis, non est, cur vel causae ejus dicendae, vel excellentiae commendandae immoremur amplius.
notes: Strimesius Latino-German edition + Prefatio 9 arguments; skip further commendation.
